figures.label: Role Growth Rate
figures.source: Niche-skill roles in AI, cloud, and security are pulling 15-25% pay increases at competitive employers, while generic, commoditised roles see only 6-8% growth.

figures.label: Skills Demand Gap
figures.source: NASSCOM reports a roughly 51% demand-supply gap in AI talent, with over 290,000 AI-related job postings in a recent year alone, and India's AI market is projected to reach around USD 17 billion by 2027, growing at roughly 25-35% a year.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One

items.text: Eight categories, wide pay bands, and a scarce-versus-crowded split is still a lot to hold in your head at once.
Do you focus best alone on a technical problem for hours, or do you get energy from talking to people and switching contexts often.
A skill that fights your natural energy pattern will not survive a genuinely tough project deadline.

blocks.heading: Avoid When Chasing a "High Salary" Skill

items.text: A senior AI architect's Rs 40 LPA salary is not what a fresher earns in year one.
A certificate proves attendance, not capability.
The best model, dashboard, or campaign in the world is worth less if you cannot explain it clearly to a manager, client, or interviewer.

visuals.heading: Rank 2: Cloud Engineering

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Entry-level AWS roles with a certification and real hands-on project work start around Rs 4-7 LPA, against Rs 3-8 LPA for the wider fresher band without a certification. Cloud security, a specialised cross-over with cybersecurity, pushes the ceiling further: fresher Rs 5-9 LPA, mid Rs 12-22 LPA, senior Rs 28-50 LPA, and lead roles Rs 50-80 LPA.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a ₹3 lakh education budget, a tenth is ₹30,000 for the main course and a fifth is ₹60,000.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Mid-level professionals with two to five years of experience move into the Rs 8-18 LPA range, senior specialists report Rs 20-50 LPA, and CISOs at large organisations report Rs 60 lakh to over Rs 1.2 crore.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Full-stack development still represents the largest hiring volume in India by raw numbers, but the pay gap inside the category is significant. Mid-level developers report Rs 10-20 LPA, and senior developers at product companies report Rs 25-60 LPA or higher, with developers who combine a modern stack, cloud skill, and strong fundamentals commanding the top end.

blocks.heading: Genuinely Scarce Versus What Is Oversaturated

items.text: Basic prompting with no domain judgment behind it.
Generic social media posting and content writing with no strategy or measurable result.
Certificate-only resumes with no real project behind the certificate.
Template dashboards and reports that any AI tool can now generate in seconds.
Entry-level data entry, market research, and basic report generation, which over 30% of Indian organisations are actively reducing hiring for as AI absorbs this work.
